event.title: I-94 eastbound: Construction work.
event.description:
Between Exit 173: Opportunity Drive and Exit 183: Wright County Road 8 (Clearwater). Look out for construction work. Width limit 11'0". Left lane closed in the eastbound direction of travel. From 7:30AM CDT to 4:00PM CDT on Tuesday and Wednesday. Until today at about 4:00PM CDT.

event.title: MN 55 in both directions: Road closed.
event.description:
Between County Road 130 and West Mill Street (Paynesville). The road is closed because of construction work and because the bridge is closed. Please follow the Minnesota DOT-recommended detour around the closure. See map for detour(s). All lanes are closed in both directions of travel. Until July 2, 2027 at about 5:00PM CDT.
